incidente.resumo: An Availability Zone in SA-EAST-1 lost utility power; during failover one generator became unavailable when its breaker opened and a second failed mechanically, and the remaining generators shut down under the excess load. Power was restored by bypassing a malfunctioning automated control system and manually bringing generators online; a misconfigured network device brought up during recovery then degraded connectivity for both Availability Zones for 20 minutes until it was taken out of service.
servicos_afetados: Instances in a single Availability Zone in SA-EAST-1
Internet connectivity for both SA-EAST-1 Availability Zones

gatilho.texto: On December 17th at 10:05PM PST, the impacted Availability Zone lost utility power due to a fault at the substation of the local utility provider, and the load switched over to backup generators as designed.
trechos: On December 17th at 10:05PM PST, the impacted Availability Zone lost utility power due to a fault that happened at the substation of the local utility provider.
In this particular case when we experienced a loss in utility power, the load switched over to our backup generators as designed.

descricao.texto: During the failover a breaker in front of one generator opened, making it unavailable, and shortly thereafter a second generator independently failed due to a mechanical issue. With two generators unavailable there was more load than the remaining healthy generators could handle, and they also shut down. Forensics on the breaker opening and the generator mechanical failure had not been completed.
trechos: During that failover a breaker in front of one of the generators opened, rendering that generator unavailable.
Shortly thereafter, a second generator independently failed due to a mechanical issue.
The loss of utility power combined with the unavailability of two additional generators meant that there was more load in the facility than the remaining healthy generators could handle.
With more load on them than they could support, the remaining healthy generators also shut down.

While we have not completed forensics on the breaker opening and the generator mechanical failure, we find the double failure to be extremely unusual, and are deeply reviewing the operational records of the failed components.

fatores_contribuintes.texto: The facility's automated control system, which aggregates power from multiple generators, was not functioning properly; the team experienced several setbacks bringing power back before identifying it, and then had to bring generators online through a slow manual process.
trechos: This facility uses an automated control system which allows it to aggregate power from multiple generators together.
The team experienced several additional setbacks when trying to bring the power infrastructure back online, and eventually identified that the automated control system wasn’t functioning properly.
Once the team identified the issue, they bypassed the automated control system and began the slow process of manually bringing the generators online.

fatores_contribuintes.texto: During recovery, a network device in the power-impacted Availability Zone was brought up manually with a bad configuration; it advertised an invalid network route, degrading Internet connectivity for both SA-EAST-1 Availability Zones for a total of 20 minutes.
trechos: As part of the recovery process, a network technician brought a network device up manually in the power-impacted Availability Zone and introduced a bad configuration.
That misconfiguration led to the device advertising an invalid network route when it came back online, which resulted in degraded Internet connectivity for both SA-EAST-1 Availability Zones.

Instances in the second Availability Zone in the Region did not experience any power related issues, however instances in both Availability Zones did experience a total of 20 minutes of degraded network connectivity due to an error that was made in bringing our network back online once power was restored.

passos.texto: The facilities team began working to bring the failed generators back online; after identifying that the automated control system was not functioning properly, they bypassed it and manually brought the generators online.
trechos: Our facilities team immediately began working to bring the failed generators back online.
Once the team identified the issue, they bypassed the automated control system and began the slow process of manually bringing the generators online.

passos.texto: Once there was sufficient generator capacity to fully support the facility, all impacted instances were recovered.
trechos: Once there was sufficient generator capacity to fully support the facility, all of the impacted instances were recovered.

passos.texto: The misconfigured network device was taken out of service, restoring full connectivity to the Region; after power and networking were fully restored, all services were brought back online.
trechos: Once we understood the issue, we took the device out of service and full connectivity to the Region was restored.
After power and networking were fully restored to the facility, all of our services were brought back online and full customer access was restored.

acoes.texto: Planned: take steps to ensure this Availability Zone in Brazil is better able to withstand a similar power failure in the future.
trechos: We appreciate how critical our services are to our customers, and will take steps to ensure this Availability Zone in Brazil is better able to withstand a similar power failure in the future.

perguntas_em_aberto: Forensics on the breaker opening and the generator mechanical failure had not been completed; the operational records of the failed components were under review.

motivo_confianca_baixa: causa_raiz: the generator overload mechanism is stated, but forensics on why the breaker opened and why the second generator failed were not completed, so incerta was chosen over concreta. The network misconfiguration during recovery is a second mechanism and was placed in fatores_contribuintes. status_relatorio final was chosen over preliminar although forensics were pending. data_incidente year comes from the publication date (December 20, 2013) written in the text, three days after the December 17th event.
